title: The Diatessaron (Section 47)
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 47

paragraphs.text: 1 {{BIBLE:joh 16:16}} A little while, and you shall not behold me; and a little while again, and you shall 2 behold me; because I go to the Father. {{BIBLE:joh 16:17}} His disciples therefore said one to another, What is this that he has said unto us, A little while, and you shall not behold me; and a little while again, and you shall behold me: and, I go to my 3 Father? {{BIBLE:joh 16:18}} And they said, What is this little while that he has said? We know not 4 what he speaks. {{BIBLE:joh 16:19}} And Jesus perceived that they were seeking to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said unto you, A little while, and you behold me not, and a little while again, and you shall 5 behold me? {{BIBLE:joh 16:20}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, that you shall weep and grieve, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be sorrowful, but your grief shall turn to joy.

6 {{BIBLE:joh 16:21}} For, a woman when the time has come for her that she should bring forth, the arrival of the day of her bringing forth distresses her: but whenever she has brought forth a son, she remembers not her distress, for joy at the birth of a man into the 7 world. {{BIBLE:joh 16:22}} And ye now also grieve: but I shall see you, and your hearts shall rejoice, 8 [Arabic, p. 178] and your joy no man takes from you. {{BIBLE:joh 16:23}} And in that day you shall ask me nothing. And verily, verily, I say unto you, All that you ask my Father in my name, he will give you. {{BIBLE:joh 16:24}} Hitherto you have asked nothing 9 in my name: ask, and you shall receive, that your joy may be complete.

10 {{BIBLE:joh 16:25}} I have spoken unto you now in ænigmas: but there will come an hour when I shall not speak to you in ænigmas, but shall reveal unto you the Father plainly, 11 in that day when you shall ask in my name: {{BIBLE:joh 16:26}} and I say not unto you, that I shall 12 entreat the Father for you; {{BIBLE:joh 16:27}} for the Father loves you, because you have loved me, 13 and have believed that I came forth from my Father. {{BIBLE:joh 16:28}} I came forth from my Father, and came into the world: and I leave the world, and go unto my Father. 14 {{BIBLE:joh 16:29}} His disciples said unto him, Lo, your speech is now plain, and you have not said one 15 thing in an ænigma. {{BIBLE:joh 16:30}} Now, lo, we know that you know everything, and needest not that any man should ask you: and by this we believe that you came forth 16, 17 from God. {{BIBLE:joh 16:31}} Jesus said unto them, Believe that an hour comes, {{BIBLE:joh 16:32}} and lo, it has come, and you shall be scattered, every one of you to his place, and shall leave me 18 alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me. {{BIBLE:joh 16:33}} This have I said unto you, that in me ye may have peace. And in the world trouble shall overtake you: but be of good courage; for I have overcome the world.

19 {{BIBLE:joh 17:1}} This said Jesus, and lifted up his eyes unto heaven, and said, My Father, the hour 20 has come; glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you: {{BIBLE:joh 17:2}} as you gave him authority 21 over all flesh, that all that you have given him, he might give them eternal life. {{BIBLE:joh 17:3}} And this is eternal life, that they should know that you alone are true God, and that he 22 [Arabic, p. 179] whom you sent is Jesus the Messiah. {{BIBLE:joh 17:4}} I glorified you in the earth, 23 and the work which you gave me to do I have accomplished. {{BIBLE:joh 17:5}} And now glorify me, O Father, beside you, with that glory which I had with you 24 before the world was. {{BIBLE:joh 17:6}} I made known your name to the men whom you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them to me; and they have kept 25, 26 your word. {{BIBLE:joh 17:7}} Now they know that all that you have given me is from you: {{BIBLE:joh 17:8}} and the sayings which you gave me I have given unto them; and they received them, and knew of a truth that I came forth from you, and believed that you sent me. 27 {{BIBLE:joh 17:9}} And I ask for their sake: and my asking is not for the world, but for those whom 28 you have given me; for they are yours: {{BIBLE:joh 17:10}} and all that is mine is yours, and all that is 29 yours is mine: and I am glorified in them. {{BIBLE:joh 17:11}} And now I am not in the world, and they are in the world, and I come to you. My holy Father, keep them in your 30 name which you have given unto me, that they may be one, as we are. {{BIBLE:joh 17:12}} When I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: and I kept those whom you gave unto me: and no man of them has perished, but the son of perdition; that 31 the scripture might be fulfilled. {{BIBLE:joh 17:13}} Now I come to you: and this I say in the world, 32 that my joy may be complete in them. {{BIBLE:joh 17:14}} I have given them your word; and the world 33 hated them, because they were not of the world, as I was not of the world. {{BIBLE:joh 17:15}} And I ask not this, that you take them from the world, but that you keep them from the 34, 35 evil one. {{BIBLE:joh 17:16}} They were not of the world, as I was not of the world. {{BIBLE:joh 17:17}} O Father, sanctify 36 them in your truth: for your word is truth. {{BIBLE:joh 17:18}} And as you sent me into the world, I 37 [Arabic, p. 180] also send them into the world. {{BIBLE:joh 17:19}} And for their sake I sanctify myself, that they 38 also may be sanctified in the truth. {{BIBLE:joh 17:20}} Neither for these alone do I ask, but for 39 the sake of them that believe in me through their word; {{BIBLE:joh 17:21}} that they may be all one; as you are in me, and I in you, and so they also shall be one in us: that the world 40 may believe that you sent me. {{BIBLE:joh 17:22}} And the glory which you have given unto 41 me I have given unto them; {{BIBLE:joh 17:23}} that they may be one, as we are one; I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfect into one; and that the world may know that 42 you sent me, and that I loved them, as you loved me. {{BIBLE:joh 17:24}} Father, and those whom you have given me, I wish that, where I am, they may be with me also; that they may behold my glory, which you have given me: for you loved me before 43 the foundation of the world. {{BIBLE:joh 17:25}} My righteous Father, and the world knew you not, 44 but I know you; and they knew that you sent me; and I made known unto them your name, and will make it known to them; {{BIBLE:joh 17:26}} that the love wherewith you loved me may be in them, and I shall be in them.
